usermeta.idiom: Boxplot (composite mark) with regions ordered by latitude
todo: Build data/reef_fish_transects.csv from the IMOS NRMN reef fish abundance and biomass download joined to site info (README, step 4). Required columns: region, latitude, biomass_kg (one row per transect).
Choose regions you can name sensibly (e.g. Great Barrier Reef, Ningaloo, Sydney, Port Phillip, Tasmania). Keep it to about 6-10 or the plot gets cramped.
Biomass is heavily skewed, so the axis is log. Zero-biomass transects are filtered out; mention that in the caption.

The 'sort' list on the y encoding sets the order of regions (north to south). Replace the example names with YOUR region names, exactly as they appear in the CSV. Sorting by a latitude field did not work for boxplots when tested, hence the explicit list.
